description: The plot illustrates the relationship between TFLOPs and Loss Ratio for different configurations of SepLLM and a Vanilla model. The x-axis represents TFLOPs on a logarithmic scale, ranging from 1e7 to 9e8, with tick labels at 1e7, 2e7, 5e7, 1e8, 2e8, 3e8, 4e8, 5e8, 6e8, 7e8, 8e8, and 9e8. The y-axis represents the Loss Ratio as a percentage on a linear scale, ranging from 94 to 100, with tick labels at 94, 95, 96, 97, 98, 99, and 100. The plot includes five lines representing different models: Vanilla (purple, solid line, star markers), SepLLM (n=64) (orange, dashed line, square markers), SepLLM (n=128) (blue, solid line, triangle markers), SepLLM (n=64, H) (green, solid line, diamond markers), and SepLLM (n=64, H/T) (red, solid line, circle markers). The Vanilla line remains steady at around 99.5% across the x-axis. The SepLLM (n=64) line starts at around 98% at 1e7 TFLOPs and increases to approximately 100% at 3e8 TFLOPs before slightly decreasing to around 99.5% at 9e8 TFLOPs. The SepLLM (n=128) line begins at around 97% at 1e7 TFLOPs and rises to about 99.5% at 2e8 TFLOPs, remaining relatively stable thereafter. The SepLLM (n=64, H) line starts at around 97.5% at 1e7 TFLOPs and increases to approximately 99.5% at 2e8 TFLOPs, then remains relatively stable. The SepLLM (n=64, H/T) line starts at around 94% at 1e7 TFLOPs and increases to about 98.5% at 3e8 TFLOPs, then decreases slightly to around 98% at 9e8 TFLOPs.
